title: Object Storage: cool credit — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage cool credit, the correction amount is the negative of the smaller of that overcharge and the maximum correction net amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; zero makes no new financial write.

## Basis Q&A

What determines cool credit in this situation? The correction amount is the negative of the smaller of that overcharge and the maximum correction net amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; zero makes no new financial write.

## Hypothetical cool credit — recorded outcome case

For this cool credit — recorded outcome example, assume a hypothetical remaining overcharge of USD 28.14 and maximum correction net of USD 19.23. The signed correction is negative USD 19.23. A zero overcharge makes no financial write.

An uncovered difference remains payable under the original charge.
